description: Issue a fresh email verification link for a customer whose status is pending and email it; the previous link stops working and the new one lasts 24 hours. Refused for a customer who is already verified or is suspended, when the workspace has no public site URL, and after five account emails to the same customer in an hour. `emailSent: false` means the link was issued but the mailer did not take the email. Only call after the user confirms.
name: resend_customer_verification
